description: Use this when the person asks which of their own safety data sheets are old or due for a review: "Which of my SDS are older than three years?". Lists the current documents of the connected account that are due for a look: safety data sheets whose revision date is older than three years (the reminder the dashboard shows) and documents without a revision date. ProofPass stores no expiry date for documents. Do not use for products that have no document at all (use list_missing_documents). ProofPass stores no expiry date.

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

name: list_documents_due
title: Documents due for review
